defs.def: to rest while you are doing sth enjoyable, especially after work or effort 放松；休息

ex.s: They will sniff out specific areas before they choose a place to relax.
ex.t: 它们在选择一个地方放松之前，会先嗅探特定区域。

ex.s: On a cool, starry night in mid-September 1870, four men relaxed before a campfire along the Firehole River in ____43____ is now northwestern Wyoming.
ex.t: 1870年9月中旬的一个凉爽星空之夜，四个人在火洞河畔的篝火旁放松休息，这里____现在是怀俄明州西北部。

ex.s: Compared to other alternatives, it’s comfortable and relaxing.
ex.t: 与其他选择相比，火车舒适又放松。

ex.s: The young banker who eats lunch at his desk is probably seen as a go-getter, while his colleagues who chat over a relaxed conference-room meal get dirty looks from the corner office.
ex.t: 在办公桌前吃午饭的年轻银行家可能被视为积极进取的人，而在轻松的会议室用餐聊天的同事却会受到角落办公室的白眼。

ex.s: Additionally, it is important to relax our body.
ex.t: 此外，放松身体也很重要。

ex.s: It also helps in keeping us calm and relaxes our mind.
ex.t: 它也有助于让我们保持冷静和放松心情。

ex.s: Many people enjoy relaxing music in the evening prior to going to bed．____37____While the validity of the idea is still being assessed，the lowered stress can even be tied back to blood pressure．Similarly, according to researchers，listening to just 30 minutes of soft music every day may help with healthy blood sugar levels， through the lowering of stress and anxiety．
ex.t: 许多人喜欢在晚上睡前听放松的音乐。____37____虽然这种观点的有效性仍在评估中但压力的降低甚至可能与血压有关。同样根据研究人员每天只需听30分钟轻音乐就可能通过减轻压力和焦虑有助于健康的血糖水平，

ex.s: People want to listen to someone who is interesting, relaxed and comfortable.
ex.t: 人们想听有趣、放松、自在的人讲话。

ex.s: Visit the shop and relax in the café.
ex.t: 参观商店并在咖啡馆休息。

ex.s: And you might find it relaxing to bring your small kid to a half-hour Story Time while you sit quietly in a corner with a good book.
ex.t: 你可能发现，带小孩去参加半小时的“故事时间”活动、而你自己安静地坐在角落读一本好书，是件很放松的事。

ex.s: The things we learn in maturity seldom involve information and skills． We learn to bear with the things we can't change． We learn to avoid self﹣pity． We learn that however much we try to please， some people are never going to love us﹣an idea that troubles at first but is eventually relaxing．
ex.t: 我们在成熟时学到的东西很少涉及信息和技能。我们学会忍受无法改变的事。我们学会避免自怜。我们学到，无论我们多么想取悦别人，有些人永远不会爱我们——这个想法起初令人困扰，但最终让人释然。

ex.s: Or are you just looking for a place to relax after a long day?
ex.t: 还是你只是想在漫长的一天后找个地方放松一下？

ex.s: Exercise energizes you, so it is more difficult to relax and have a peaceful sleep when you are very excited.
ex.t: 运动让你精神振奋，所以当你非常兴奋时，更难放松并安睡。

ex.s: The relaxing colors of the wall.
ex.t: 墙上令人放松的颜色。

ex.s: Although I was in embarrassed, his words made me a lot more relaxed!
ex.t: 虽然我很尴尬，但他的话让我放松多了！

ex.s: If you need a good night's sleep, choose a tea that helps you relax.
ex.t: 如果你需要一个好的夜间睡眠，选择一种有助于放松的茶。

ex.s: Cooking together gives us a chance to relax and catch up on each other’s days.
ex.t: 一起做饭给了我们一个放松和聊聊各自一天的机会。

ex.s: We work all year, so why can’t one day be about spending time with family and relaxing?
ex.t: 我们全年都在工作，所以为什么不能有一天是用来陪伴家人和放松的呢？

ex.s: It involves doing very slow physical exercises to relax your mind and calm your body.
ex.t: 它涉及做非常缓慢的身体练习来放松你的心灵和平静你的身体。

defs.def: to become or make sb become calmer and less worried 宽慰；（使）冷静，放心，镇定

ex.s: Yet， now that I'm growing and the world I once knew as being so simple is becoming more complex， I find myself needing a way to escape． By opening a novel， I can leave behind my burdens and enter into a wonderful and mysterious world where I am now a new character． In these worlds I can become anyone． I don't have to write down what happened or what technique the author was using when he or she wrote this． I just read to relax．
ex.t: 我打开一本小说，就可以抛下重担，进入一个奇妙神秘的世界，在那里我成了一个新角色。在这些世界里我可以是任何一个人。我不必写下发生了什么，也不必写下作者写作时用了什么技巧。我只是为了放松而读。

defs.def: to become or make sth become less tight or stiff （使）放松，松懈；松开
to allow rules, laws, etc. to become less strict 放宽（限制等）

ex.s: I have the same 24 hours in a day as you do, but I have made specific choice that allow me to make the most of every day and still feel happy and relaxed. ____11____
ex.t: 我和你一样一天只有24小时，但我做出了特定的选择，让我能够充分利用每一天，同时仍然感到快乐和放松。____11____

defs.def: to allow your attention or effort to become weaker 放松精神（或思想）
